import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = data[1:1 + n]
    mags = [abs(int(x)) for x in arr]
    vals = [x.decode() for x in arr]
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        p = mags[i]
        vi = vals[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            q = mags[j]
            # With a = min, b = max of |x|, |y|: condition 2 always holds, condition 1 is b <= 2a.
            if (q <= 2 * p) if p <= q else (p <= 2 * q):
                out.append(vi + ' ' + vals[j])
    sys.stdout.write(str(len(out)) + '\n')
    if out:
        sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')


main()
